from.name: DNS Resource Record typed extension framework

property: The existing DNS typed-record container is reused to add a 128-bit IPv6 address RR while retaining the DNS database/wire architecture.

sources.supports: generic RR structure and TYPE-based RDATA interpretation
AAAA RR added in a way designed for compatibility with existing DNS applications/implementations

negative_claims: AAAA is not a revision of A; the two address-record types coexist for different IP versions.
This edge does not imply IPv6 is derived from IPv4 DNS semantics.
open_questions: Promote AAAA as its own artifact if implementation-level archaeology deepens.
